newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Ind, FPD own 65 pct Island Dyeing.
newsitem.headline: SHK Ind, FPD own 65 pct Island Dyeing.

text.p: SHK Hong Kong Industries, First Pacific Davies Limited (FPD) and parties acting in concert said they will hold an aggregate 64.84 percent of Island Dyeing and Printing Co Ltd on completion of cash offer.
SHK Hong Kong, FPD, and parties in concert will hold 33.71, 29.84 and 1.29 percent respectively of Island Dyeing following completion of the offer, they said in a joint statement.
SHK Hong Kong and FPD are to take up a respective 56 and 44 percent of the offer acceptances, it said.

Pursuant to an underwriting agreement, SHK Hong Kong's share of acceptances have been taken up by independent underwriters and completion of the placing is expected to take place within 10 days from the closing date of the offer on December 3.
In October, SHK Hong Kong Industries and FPD, a unit of First Pacific Co Ltd, launched a formal bid of HK$7.60 per share for all outstanding shares in Island Dyeing.
In September SHK Hong Kong had bought a 45 percent stake in Island Dyeing from Itochu Corp, Itochu Hong Kong Ltd, and Daido-Maruta Finishing Co Ltd for HK$225.72 million.
In addition, FPD and parties acting in concert with it acquired an additional 28.80 percent of the issued share capital of Island Dyeing. -- Hong Kong newsroom (852) 2843 6370
